articles.summary: If your goal for 2021 is to grow your book of business, you’ll certainly face challenges. If your goal for 2021 is to grow profitably, then you’ve just upped the degree of difficulty significantly. But at the same time, who doesn’t want profitable growth? Our customers certainly do, which is why they ranked achieving profitable growth among their top five strategic imperatives for 2021 when we surveyed them at Connections Reimagined in November 2020.
articles.title: Profitable Growth: The Best Kind of Growth
